title: The Digital Mirror: Gender Bias and Occupational Stereotypes in AI-Generated Images

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models (DALL·E 3 and Ideogram) with various occupations based on real-world gender distribution statistics, and using thematic analysis to evaluate gender representation ratios, emotional expressions (e.g., smiling), and occupational stereotypes in the generated images.

Coding AI-generated images of professionals for visible signs of ageing (such as wrinkles and greying hair or beards) and comparing the frequency of these traits across genders and hierarchical roles (e.g., students vs. professors).
